Share of children who achieve minimum reading proficiency by the end of primary education. This data accounts for school
completion rates to estimate skills for all children, not just those in school.
Data source: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (2026); World Bank (2026)
Note: Where data for 2023 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2018 and 2025 is shown instead.
